'''''Legacy''''' is a  ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel that was  published in hardcover by [[Random House Worlds]] on [[July 28]], [[2026]] alongside [[Legacy (audiobook)|its audiobook]].<ref name="RHW" /> It was officially announced at New York Comic Con on [[October 11]], [[2025]], where it was revealed to be a story written by [[Madeleine Roux]] focusing on [[Rey Skywalker|Rey's]] [[Jedi training]] between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="Twitter" />

It had an early release at [[Wikipedia:San Diego Comic-Con|San Diego Comic-Con]] on [[July 23]], with exclusive jacket art.<ref name="Legacy SDCC" />
